sentences.en: The contrast between the sky and the mountain is striking.
sentences.zh: 天空和山之间的对比非常鲜明。

sentences.en: The dress has a beautiful contrast between red and white.
sentences.zh: 这件衣服在红色与白色之间形成了美丽的对比。

sentences.en: He looked quite happy in contrast with those around him.
sentences.zh: 他看起来和其他人很不一样，显得很高兴。

senses.zh: 对比, 对照 - 差异, 差别 - 对照物, 明显的对比物 -
